## 1. What you have
5 of your 50 installed skills fit.

- **landing-page-generator**: use it if you want the page as a Next.js TSX component with Tailwind. It writes the copy with the PAS, AIDA or BAB framework and adds SEO meta tags.
  `call: /landing-page-generator <what you want>`
- **landing**: use it if you want one high-end HTML file with 3D CSS, GSAP scroll effects and parallax. It starts with a short set of questions to pin down how you position the product.
  `call: /landing <what you want>`
- **epic-design**: use it if the page should feel cinematic, with scrollytelling, text reveals and Apple-style motion. It needs `pip: Pillow`.
  `call: /epic-design <what you want>`
- **copywriting**: use it for the headline, tagline and call-to-action text before you build. It scores candidate headlines against each other.
  `call: /copywriting <what you want>`
- **page-cro**: use it after the page is live, if it isn't getting signups or sales. It audits each section and ranks the fixes by impact.
  `call: /page-cro <what you want>`
